title: HomePage loading skeleton must mirror the real section order
answers: Homepage skeleton flashes sections in the wrong order while loading
Loading placeholder on home page doesn't match final layout order
Where to update the homepage skeleton after reordering sections
body:
Symptom: on the redesigned homepage, the loading skeleton shows blocks in a different order than the loaded content, causing a visible layout shift.
Root cause: HomePageSkeleton.tsx renders its JSX blocks (Recommendations/Overview skeleton vs Dashboards/Alerts grid skeleton) independently from HomePage.tsx's actual render order.
Fix pattern: whenever HomePage.tsx's section order changes (e.g. moving a HomeGrid above/below Recommendations), move the matching block in HomePageSkeleton.tsx to the same position so skeleton order == real order.
Constraints: applies to public/app/features/home/HomePage.tsx and HomePageSkeleton.tsx under the grafana.growthHomepage redesign branch; does not apply to the legacy (non-redesign) branch which is unaffected.
